title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the Pro elementor.pro.theme.create tool
_comment: WP-R07 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §1.8). elementor.pro.theme.create is MUTATING (class M, side proxied-to-REST: POST elementor-ultra/v1/pro/theme — PHP documents->create(type,…) + Document::save + Conditions_Manager::save_conditions). It is a NON-★ Pro tool, so the lean profile registers it DISABLED at boot; the smoke driver must enable it (tools.search 'elementor.pro.theme') before invoking. It CREATES a NEW header theme doc (status:'draft'), so it does not touch any shared disposable draft; the driver trashes the created post_id in teardown. Gated on `requires.pro:true` so a free-only install SKIPS rather than fails (the PHP route returns 501 PRO_REQUIRED otherwise → mapped to an isError, never a -326xx). MINIMAL valid input per §1.8: REQUIRED {type,title}; we set status:'draft' explicitly and omit elements/page_settings/conditions (all optional). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {post_id, edit_url, template_type, location, conditions_stored}.
